from scipy.optimize import least_squares
y=dv_dt
forms={
'two cos':(lambda p:p[0]*np.cos(p[1]*t+p[2])+p[3]*np.cos(p[4]*t+p[5])+p[6],7),
'cos*exp':(lambda p:p[0]*np.exp(p[4]*t)*np.cos(p[1]*t+p[2])+p[3],5),
'cos+lin':(lambda p:p[0]*np.cos(p[1]*t+p[2])+p[3]+p[4]*t,5),
'cos tpow':(lambda p:p[0]*np.cos(p[1]*t**p[4]+p[2])+p[3],5),
'cos sin nested':(lambda p:p[0]*np.cos(p[1]*t+p[2]+p[4]*np.sin(p[5]*t+p[6]))+p[3],7),
'cos+cos^2':(lambda p:p[0]*np.cos(p[1]*t+p[2])+p[3]+p[4]*np.cos(p[1]*t+p[2])**2+p[5]*np.cos(p[1]*t+p[2])**3,6),
'cos+tpow':(lambda p:p[0]*np.cos(p[1]*t+p[2])+p[3]+p[4]*t**p[5],6),
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
for nm,(f,n) in forms.items():
    best=None
    for k in range(40):
        p0=rng.normal(0,1,n); p0[0]=4.3;p0[1]=0.7;p0[2]=5.18+rng.normal(0,.3);p0[3]=-2.2
        try:
            s=least_squares(lambda p:f(p)-y,p0)
        except Exception as e: continue
        if best is None or s.cost<best.cost: best=s
    print(nm,np.mean(best.fun**2)/np.var(y),best.x.round(5))
